title: HedgerX Debuts on CoinMarketCap With AI Trading and Bitcoin Treasury Plans
summary: The cryptocurrency exchange continues to expand its AI trading tools, strengthen compliance standards, and partner with trading communities worldwide. The entity was recently listed on CoinMarketCap (CMC), allowing traders, industry researchers, and prospective partners to access a public source of information about the exchange.
